theorems.name: Submission.tangentialGradient_comp_of_differentiableAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (x : Ambient n ℓ), DifferentiableAt ℝ h x → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ (h x) → V.tangentialGradient (fun y ↦ ψ (h y)) x = deriv ψ (h x) • V.tangentialGradient h x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
